# Make a plot for each variable across longitud
plots <- lapply(seq_along(env_vars), function(i) {
  
  v <- env_vars[i]
  
  # Variable Y
  y_var <- if (i == 1) "awi_pm_sr_yr" else v
  
  # Correlation
  test <- cor.test(
    datos_bio$Long,
    datos_bio[[y_var]],
    method = "pearson"
  )
  
  r <- unname(test$estimate)
  p <- test$p.value
  
  # Text
  label <- paste0(
    "r = ", round(r, 2),
    "\np = ", format.pval(p, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)
  )
  
  ggplot(datos_bio, aes(x = Long, y = .data[[y_var]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = FALSE
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = label,
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = 1.3,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Longitude (°)",
      y = if (i == 1) {
        "Aridity index"
      } else {
        sub("wc2\\.1_5m_", "", v)
      }
    )
)
